usedFor: Loyverse holds receipts, items and shifts, and Google Docs receives the text through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Receipt Created” in Loyverse, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each sale leaves a receipt, and the action writes it into a document tab as a record.

watchOut: “New Receipt Created” in Loyverse is polling, so the tab updates after a scheduled check, not at the till.
